mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of Origin (e.g., foundation certificate or formation document of the localizing entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies in the jurisdiction of origin (where applicable) or Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) if re-domiciling

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (or equivalent constitutional documents) of the applicant entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency (dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or licensed registered agent in the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of each director, shareholder, and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public / consular officer (birth country or residence)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Financial reference letter from a licensed bank or regulated financial institution in the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Banking institution subject to FATF-compliant KYC standards

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized sworn declaration of lawful source of funds and source of wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory real-time screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against PEP (domestic and foreign), OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu's national sanctions list maintained by the VFSC and the Financial Intelligence Unit. Enhanced due diligence required where any PEP designation or adverse media flags appear; results must be documented and retained for at least 5 years post-termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Registry – Name Reservation and Incorporation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in Latin script characters. The name may be in English, French, or Bislama, but the registered Latin-script version prevails. Where names are transliterated from a non-Latin script, a certified transliteration must be submitted. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or an approved abbreviation such as 'Ltd', 'Corp', or 'Inc' for an International Company.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days upon payment of a renewal fee and submission of a written extension request to VFSC at least 7 business days prior to expiration. If the name is rejected, the submitting applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The appeal must state grounds of non-confusion and distinguish the proposed name from any existing or reserved name. The Registrar shall respond within 15 business days. A further appeal may be made to the Vanuatu Financial Services Authority Appeals Tribunal within 21 days. Rejection fees are non-refundable.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For an International Company, a physical registered office in Vanuatu is mandatory, maintained by a licensed registered agent. The agent's office address may serve as the registered office, but pure virtual office services without a physical presence in Vanuatu are not accepted. Commercial substance requirements for this industry are minimal; the localization agency must maintain a registered agent, a registered office, and keep adequate accounting records (which may be hosted electronically). Outsourcing of multilingual production activities is permitted, but core decision-making records should be accessible in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 2% per annum (quantified risk of unannounced on-site inspection by the VFSC or the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit for low-risk, non-licensed standard entities engaged in translation and media localization).

Contingency reserve for registry variances, re-filings, or emergency courier

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] of Vanuatu, Sections 4 (Incorporation), 5 (Memorandum and Articles), 8 (Share Capital), 13 (Registered Office and Agent), and 18 (Officers), as amended.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an International Company (Form IC-1) filed with the Registrar of International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; capital may be expressed in any currency; no escrow bank account or statutory deposit obligation is imposed on an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that each subscriber identified in the register of members hereby subscribes for and takes up the number of shares allocated to that subscriber and agrees to pay the full issue price for those shares in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company shall be situated at the office of its licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the registered agent is hereby appointed to act for the Company. RESOLVED that the persons named in the register of directors and in the register of officers shall respectively act as directors and as secretary and officers of the Company from the date of this resolution until replaced or removed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name search and reservation request to the VFSC through a licensed registered agent. The name must not conflict with any existing company, trade mark, or prohibited name and must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or an approved abbreviation. Upon approval, the name is reserved for a statutory period, usually 14 to 30 days, within which the incorporation application must be lodged.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Request Letter signed by the proposed incorporator or registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected on grounds of similarity or prohibition, resubmit an amended name list of up to three alternative names, or file a written explanation detailing the lawful reason for the proposed use; the Registrar's objection may also be challenged in writing within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent in Vanuatu, operating under the VFSC regulatory framework.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, and any consents of directors and shareholders. The subscribers execute the Memorandum and Articles before a notary or other officer authorized to take declarations. Certified English-language versions must be maintained, and all passport or legal personality documentation must be notarized or apostilled, if required.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association signed by each subscriber
Articles of Association signed by each subscriber
Consent to Act as Director signed by each director
Consent to Act as Shareholder signed or acknowledged by each shareholder
Certified passports, national identity cards, or certificate of incorporation for corporate shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries execution, authentication, or content, correct the specific deficiency via re-execution or re-notarization and file a written reply accompanied by revised instruments within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Corporate Registry, International Companies Division, Port Vila.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent electronically and in hard copy lodges Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, the name reservation approval, officer consents, and registered office details. The statutory incorporation fee of USD 250, plus applicable agency fees, must be paid by bank transfer or approved electronic payment. Upon receipt, the Registry reviews the application for completeness and statutory compliance.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Application for Registration as an International Company
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered office and registered agent details
Proof of payment of government filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, the registered agent may file a corrected Form IC-1 within 14 calendar days, curing any omissions or irregularities without a fresh waiting period, provided the original application was lodged in good faith.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Company Number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval and receipt of all statutory documents, the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation under the official seal of VFSC, assign a company number, and enter the International Company in the public register maintained by the Commission. The certificate will state the date of incorporation and the registered name. The registered agent retrieves the certificate and delivers it to the beneficial owners.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains clerical or identifying errors, submit a written request for rectification to the Registrar together with the original certificate and supporting evidence; correction is ordinarily effected within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Establishment of Corporate Governance Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company, supported by the licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The newly incorporated entity holds its first board meeting or adopts a unanimous written resolution to confirm the share allotment, adopt the registered office and registered agent appointment, elect officers, open corporate bank accounts where relevant, and approve the corporate seal and minute book. All resolutions must be recorded in the minutes and filed in the statutory records kept at the registered office or with the registered agent. If required for operational banking, a certified extract of the resolution is issued by the secretary.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution minutes or written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a regulatory or banking counterparty disputes the validity of the first board resolution, the board may ratify an additional confirmatory resolution, with a certified copy and legal opinion from a Vanuatu licensed attorney, to remove any procedural doubt.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — Vanuatu does not impose a sectoral industrial license for professional multilingual translation, media dubbing, or localization agency activities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for the registered commercial activity under the ISIC 7490 / NAICS 541930 classification.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Government of Vanuatu.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Environmental Review not required — office-based localization activity is classified as a low-impact non-industrial operation; a full EIA is not required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or significant atmospheric emissions are generated. Where small recording or dubbing studios are operated, the activity must comply with Vanuatu's Waste Management Regulations and general noise control requirements applicable to non-residential premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire Services is required before occupying any commercial office premises; a structural load inspection certificate and an occupational workplace clearance are obtained from the building owner or the Public Works Department where fit-out is carried out, and the employer must register with the Vanuatu National Provident Fund for workplace insurance coverage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Republic of Vanuatu — official portal: https://www.dcir.gov.vu; digital TIN and VAT administration under the Tax Administration Act No. 4 of 2013 and the Value Added Tax Act No. 10 of 1998.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident International Company (VU_IC) obtains its TIN/VAT ID by filing a TIN/VAT registration form with the DCIR through its licensed resident agent, accompanied by: certificate of incorporation and status excerpt from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), registered-agent licence and address, constitutional documents, director/shareholder particulars, and the prescribed registration fee. Registration for VAT is mandatory where taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceed VUV 10,000,000 in any consecutive 12-month period; below that, voluntary VAT registration may be approved. Because the localization services are rendered wholly offshore, the IC's routine supply activity does not create a Vanuatu VAT registration obligation; a TIN is nonetheless issued for customs, payroll, and administrative purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — an exempt International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu national direct taxes (no corporate income tax, personal income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, estate or inheritance duty, or stamp duty), and, being outside the domestic VAT net for offshore services, is not required to charge Vanuatu VAT; exemptions are strictly territorial and do not displace source-country or residence-country taxation of the beneficial owners.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: At incorporation, the VU_IC may elect 'exempt' or 'non-exempt' status by filing the prescribed election with VFSC; an exempt IC pays registration and annual maintenance fees in lieu of all Vanuatu taxes. Vanuatu has no domestic check-the-box, classification, or hybrid-mismatch election because no income tax exists; any flow-through or entity-level classification (e.g., US 8832, EU/UK rules) is a function of the foreign jurisdiction's law, not Vanuatu law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) imposed by the Value Added Tax Act No. 10 of 1998, administered nationally by the DCIR; no separate GST or state-level sales/use tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period (compulsory registration triggered after exceeding the threshold; voluntary registration available below the threshold; registration application due within 21 days of month-end in which threshold is crossed).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory real-time e-invoicing, fiscal-clearance controller, API-based clearance, or digital-stamping regime is currently in force in Vanuatu. VAT invoices may be paper or electronic and must contain the prescribed particulars (sequential invoice number, issue date, supplier name and VAT/TIN registration number, recipient name, description and quantity, consideration exclusive/inclusive of VAT, and the VAT amount). VAT registration, returns, and payments are processed electronically through the DCIR portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the VAT Act, supplies qualify for zero rating where: (i) goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within the statutorily prescribed export window (generally 28 days from supply, or an extended period approved by the DCIR) with prescribed export documentation; or (ii) services are supplied to a non-resident for use wholly outside Vanuatu, including offshore professional, translation, interpretation, transcription, subtitling, dubbing, and localization services delivered to overseas clients. The supplier must retain objective evidence of the offshore recipient, offshore performance/use, and payment from abroad. Input VAT borne on goods/services acquired in Vanuatu and used in making zero-rated exports is creditable and refundable, subject to a DCIR compliance review.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CED) accepted by the Vanuatu Customs Division of the DCIR
VAT tax invoice / commercial invoice identifying the foreign buyer and export consideration
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical exportation (goods) or signed delivery/performance report (services)
Packing list and certificate of origin (where requested by DCIR audits)
Signed service agreement or localization contract specifying delivery to a non-resident and offshore use
Bank SWIFT/remittance credit advice or Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing receipt of foreign consideration
VAT return and supporting working papers supporting the input-VAT refund claim
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rated export claims are scrutinized by the DCIR through document-based audits, third-party banking information, and beneficiary-owner tracing. Where zero rating is unsupported, fraudulent, or fails documentary substantiation, the DCIR may: reassess VAT at the 12.5% rate on the full consideration; charge interest until full payment; impose administrative penalties of up to double the tax evaded (with higher penalties for deliberate concealment or falsified documentation); claw back any refunds paid with interest; and pursue criminal prosecution, fines, and imprisonment of directors/agents under the VAT Act, Customs Act, and Tax Administration Act. Vanuatu has no exchange-control restriction on export proceeds, but the 180-day repatriation benchmark aligns the documentary evidence chain with the audit and litigation windows.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), the national central bank and financial-services regulator responsible for monetary policy, bank supervision and the issuance of the Vanuatu Vatu (VUV).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has no standalone foreign-exchange-control statute and no requirements for central-bank approval of current or capital account transactions. The Vatu is de facto fully convertible for an International Company (IC); profits, dividends, liquidation surpluses and service revenues may be freely remitted to any jurisdiction. The practical constraints are limited to anti-money-laundering / counter-terrorist-financing (AML/CFT) checks by commercial banks, documentary evidence of the economic substance of the receipts, and the absence of a deep interbank FX market requiring banks to use cross-border counterparties for forward pricing. Profit remittance from the IC to its non-resident parent or shareholders is lawful without withholding tax, but the remitting bank may require a board resolution, the IC's tax-exemption certificate, financial statements and a declaration from the beneficial owner to ensure that the remittance is not used to disguise illicit flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu does not impose any statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation, mandatory conversion ratio or repatriation timetable. A Vanuatu International Company performing professional multilingual translation and media dubbing services may invoice clients in foreign currency and retain 100% of export receipts in a VUV- or foreign-currency denominated bank account at a licensed commercial bank. No exchange-control licence is required to hold USD, EUR, GBP, AUD or other currencies offshore. The only conventional requirement is that such receipts be routed through a licensed banking channel consistent with the AML/CFT (Financial Transactions Reporting) Act, which imposes record-keeping and suspicious-transaction reporting duties.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: HIGH for cross-border disbursement aggregation, MEDIUM for regulatory certainty. Vanuatu does not maintain a local electronic-money-institution (EMI) licensing category; offshore EMIs such as Wise and Payoneer are not locally regulated as banks or deposit-takers. Their services can be used as payment clearing and collection rails for a Vanuatu International Company, provided that (i) the EMI holds a requisite money-transmitter licence in its home jurisdiction, (ii) the IC maintains a compliant relationship with a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank for any VUV-denominated settlement, and (iii) the EMI account is not used to circumvent Vanuatu banking supervision, capital-market promotion restrictions or the IC's corporate-lending prohibition. The IC may lawfully receive USD/EUR client transfers via EMI rails and disburse to global linguists and studios, but capital injections and dividend routes should remain in the formal SWIFT banking ecosystem to avoid intermediary-bank rejection due to apparent lack of substance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the default expectation for Vanuatu IC account opening: most Tier-1 banks require either one physical visit by a director and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) to Port Vila for an in-person interview, or a FATF-equivalent 'banker's introduction' from a recognised international bank supplemented by apostilled corporate documents. Fully remote opening is uncommon for newly formed ICs; the bank may waive the physical interview only where the IC has a clean trading history, a credible law-firm reference, a registered-agent relationship with a licensed Vanuatu service provider, and the applicant director provides a verified passport via a video KYC tool subject to bank discretion. A letter of engagement from the registered agent confirming the IC's good standing substantially increases the likelihood of remote onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company veil and nominee-shareholder structure perceived as lacking ownership transparency
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete UBO chart with certified passport copies, a Certificate of Incumbency issued by the Vanuatu registered agent, a declaration of no bearer shares, signed minutes of the board resolving the account mandate, and any nominee deed/trust document proving the ultimate owner's identity and economic rights.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient business substance for a professional multilingual translation and media dubbing agency
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a business plan describing the localization workflow, target end-markets, signed licensing or master-service agreements, a list of subcontracting linguists and voice artists, room/studio booking contracts, samples of prior deliverables, and invoices issued to international clients demonstrating ongoing commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for non-resident capital injections above bank-specified thresholds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide bank statements of the investing shareholder for 12 months or longer, a source-of-wealth affidavit, tax clearance certificates from the investor's residence/jurisdiction, public securities or property sale contracts, and a professional reference from the forwarding bank confirming the wire's economic purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction velocity and one-off first-time counterparty payments to freelance contractors in diverse jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Furnish a beneficiary due-diligence policy, individual contractor agreements, a copy of the IC's internal KYC template, a PEP and sanctions-screening log, and a rolling cash-flow forecast of expected disbursements to substantiate the pattern of recurrent and legitimate service payments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived circumvention of sanctions or jurisdiction risk through funds received via third-party payment aggregators
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a SWIFT- or EMI-level transaction trail, a country-risk matrix of clients and contractors, corroborating evidence of the ultimate source and destination of each material inbound transfer, and the EMI's own money-service-business licence and compliance policy signed as an exhibit by the IC's compliance officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound routing for an equity injection into a Vanuatu International Company: (i) the shareholder executes an outward SWIFT MT103 from a bank account held in its legal name, stating the purpose code 'Capital contribution/Equity investment in non-resident company' and the beneficiary as the IC's foreign-currency (USD) account at a Vanuatu commercial bank. (ii) The IC forwards to the receiving bank the board resolution approving the issuance of shares, Certificate of Incumbency, Certificate of Good Standing, the registered agent's confirmation of share allotment, and UBO/source-of-funds documentation. (iii) The receiving bank performs AML screening and, for amounts above its internal threshold, may seek confirmation from the registered agent that the contribution aligns with a valid share issue. (iv) Upon credit, the proceeds are recorded as paid-up share capital in the IC's register of members; they need not be converted into VUV because the account is a permitted foreign-currency account and Vanuatu imposes no forced conversion. (v) For injections from a related group company, the purpose code should be 'Intercompany loan' or 'Equity investment' consistently, and an intercompany loan agreement must be maintained to avoid recharacterisation by correspondent banks.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The preferred clearing rails for outbound disbursements by the localization agency are, in order of use: (a) SWIFT MT103 single customer credit transfers for all material payments to vendors, studios and enterprise partners; (b) Wise and Payoneer multi-currency disbursement rails for micro-payments to independent linguists and dubbing talent, particularly in EUR, GBP, AUD and USD; (c) commercial irrevocable letters of credit (UCP600) where a contractual guarantee is mandatory for a media client; and (d) only in exceptional cases, international cards and RippleNet or similar crypto-fiat rails, subject to the IC's compliance policy. Every MT103 instruction must include a clear service-fee purpose code, an invoice reference, and a delivery-acceptance certificate; for payments routed through EMI rails, the IC must retain at least the invoice, the EMI transaction reference and the contractor's payment confirmation to reconstruct the chain in full.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu / US Dollar (VUV/USD) and VUV/EUR deliverable outright forwards
VUV major-currency FX swaps between the IC and a licensed commercial bank under an ISDA or master treasury agreement
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD/EUR/AUD for medium-term liquidity exposure
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) offered by international banking partners on a costlier basis when a fundable VUV market is unavailable
Vanuatu Vatu against United States dollar (VUV/USD) short-dated options, including European-style call/put options, as purely protecting hedging instruments
Synthetic hedging through term deposits in the corresponding settlement currency matched against a fully converted receivable contract

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Government Renewal Fee Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalties assessed monthly on unpaid fee; continued non-payment for 3–6 months triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not applicable – Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from independent audit, financial statement preparation, and filing; audit obligations arise only from external lender agreements or voluntary board resolutions
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework prescribed for International Companies; IFRS or simplified local GAAP may be adopted for internal management and creditor reporting

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation filing with VFSC exists; however, the licensed Vanuatu registered agent must maintain current beneficial ownership records under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2021, and any share transfer must be recorded with the company registers and reported to the registered agent

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for International Companies; voluntary compilation or agreed-upon procedures USD 800–2,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax and no inheritance/estate tax. An International Company (IC) is specifically exempt from all taxation on income, profits and distributions under the International Companies Act. The localization agency business structure is therefore a statutory tax-exempt offshore vehicle, not a tax-holiday concession. VAT at 12.5% is the only material indirect tax exposure, limited to taxable supplies consumed in Vanuatu or imports; exported multilingual services are generally outside Vanuatu VAT or zero-rated where available.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. Every International Company must instead maintain its legal existence through the VFSC-registered agent using the prescribed International Company Annual Return/Declaration. The filing is lodged through the VFSC electronic portal and the licensed registered agent's secure filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual declaration and prescribed VFSC government fee are due within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation. A late fee and penalty interest apply if payment is made after the deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, VFSC registration number, incorporation date, registered office address and registered agent contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete all fields in English. A non-resident beneficial owner does not require a Vanuatu tax identification number; the VFSC uses the IC registration number for all correspondence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of shareholders, class and number of shares issued, and details of nominee arrangements or bearer shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may be 100% foreign. Full beneficial ownership details must be disclosed to the registered agent for AML/CFT purposes; bearer shares are permitted only if immobilized with the registered agent or a prescribed custodian.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, residential addresses, dates of birth, nationality and passport numbers of all directors and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are allowed. Vanuatu does not impose a local residency or nationality requirement for directors; the written consent of each director is retained by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu, has no Vanuatu real property, has maintained its registered agent/office, and has satisfied applicable economic substance requirements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must certify compliance. If claiming tax residence in a foreign jurisdiction for economic substance purposes, attach a current certificate of residence or foreign tax filing evidence; otherwise the IC must meet substance indicators inside Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission of the annual declaration and VFSC fee triggers an escalating late payment surcharge and, after repeated default, a Registrar-initiated strike-off. A struck-off IC ceases to have legal capacity; directors and shareholders may face civil liability for obligations incurred after compulsory discontinuation, and restoration of the register requires court application and payment of all arrears, penalties and legal costs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (VAT 100 / electronic return) - applicable only if the localization agency is or must be registered for Vanuatu VAT. Registration is mandatory when annual taxable supplies reach VT 4,000,000. The return is filed through the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue e-filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly or as stated on the VAT registration certificate
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VAT return and payable VAT are due no later than the last working day of the month following the end of the taxable period. Exported localization and dubbing services supplied to non-resident clients are generally zero-rated or outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total value of taxable supplies made during the period and the corresponding 12.5% output VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Vanuatu-consumed taxable supplies in Box 1. If export services are treated as zero-rated or outside scope, report them only in the designated export reconciliation field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total VAT paid on eligible business purchases and imports, supported by valid tax invoices and customs entry documents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident sourced invoices from overseas vendors generally do not carry Vanuatu VAT and are not eligible input tax deductions in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Difference between output VAT and input VAT. A negative balance produces a refund claim subject to Inland Revenue verification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A localization agency with exclusively non-resident clients may claim a refund of input VAT on local costs, but refunds are subject to documentary checks and possible audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file VAT returns or understating output VAT attracts late filing penalties, interest on unpaid VAT, and civil penalties of up to 200% of the assessed shortfall under the VAT Act. Fraudulent VAT behavior is a criminal offense carrying fines in Vatu and imprisonment for responsible officers.

unused_local_reference.note: Vanuatu does not maintain separate provisional corporate tax forms or fringe benefits tax forms because no corporate income tax is imposed.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. Consequently, the standard DTA relief protocol (tax authority approval and foreign TRC submission) is unavailable. Dividend distributions by an IC to non-resident shareholders are completely free of Vanuatu withholding tax, so no avoidance mechanism is needed. Where a foreign shareholder's home jurisdiction grants foreign tax credit, the IC should obtain from VFSC a Certificate of Good Standing and, if useful, a certified statement of non-taxation signed by the Vanuatu Ministry of Finance and the registered agent. Such certificates evidence the IC's existence and exempt status but do not constitute a tax residency certificate under an income tax treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu imposes a 0% statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and debt interest. Because there are no tax treaties, the statutory 0% is the final effective rate. An IC licensing localization IP or lending treasury funds to affiliated companies will not suffer Vanuatu tax on the income received or on the outbound payment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A - Vanuatu has no domestic transfer pricing legislation, no Local File/Master File threshold, and no requirement to lodge transfer pricing documentation with VFSC. However, for cross-border related-party localization contracts, the IC should maintain contemporaneous OECD-aligned evidence of arm's length pricing to defend against foreign jurisdiction transfer pricing and CFC adjustments, particularly where the counterparty is in a jurisdiction with documentation thresholds such as EUR 1,000,000 or USD 1,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu Economic Substance regulations apply to International Companies carrying on relevant activities, including services, IP, banking, leasing, financing, shipping and insurance. A multilingual localization and dubbing agency entered on ISIC 7490 clearly falls within the 'services' category. It must demonstrate, for each financial year, that in Vanuatu it maintains adequate physical office space, premises or property; employs full-time employees proportionate to its activity; incurs local operating expenditure; and exercises board-level direction and management in Vanuatu. If the IC is tax resident in another recognized jurisdiction, it may instead satisfy the regime by submitting credible proof of foreign tax residence; otherwise VFSC will treat the IC as non-resident and require full substance reporting. Failure to meet economic substance obligations is a strict liability offense and may result in financial penalties, sanctions, and ultimately strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The International Company carries on business in Vanuatu, holds an interest in Vanuatu land, or engages in banking/insurance/domestic trade with Vanuatu residents while nonetheless representing itself as an offshore exempt IC. Even isolated local invoicing for fast-turnaround localization services can trigger the prohibition.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may impose a monetary penalty, issue a compliance direction, and ultimately strike the IC off the register. The IC forfeits its tax exemption and becomes liable for all taxes that apply to an ordinary Vanuatu company, though Vanuatu has no income tax to assess.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly allow domestic business to be transacted face personal liability for amounts owed and for any loss suffered by third parties. The corporate veil is pierced, and the court may issue domestic asset freezing orders, director disqualification, and restrictions on travel where funds are dissipated.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately failing to register for VAT when the localization agency exceeds the VT 4,000,000 turnover threshold, issuing false invoices, claiming input VAT credits on personal or non-business expenditure, or orchestrating fraudulent VAT refund claims.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under the VAT Act; fines presently set at up to VT 10,000,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years on conviction. Civil penalties automatically apply and may reach 200% of the unpaid tax plus daily interest on arrears.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior managers personally who directed or permitted the false return are personally and jointly liable for the unpaid VAT, penalties and costs. Directors may also be prosecuted under the directors' duty provisions; a criminal conviction triggers travel bans, sequestration of assets, and disqualification from managing any Vanuatu-registered entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Deficient Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a paper shell with no registered agent, no physical office, no local decision-making, no genuine staff, and no demonstrable substance for the purported localization activities; or claiming foreign tax residence without current documentary proof while failing to file ESR returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may levy an ESR-specific financial penalty per year of default, cancel the IC's registration, and report the entity to international tax enforcement partners. An IC that remains non-compliant for consecutive periods is automatically entered into a public strike-off list and may later be dissolved by court order.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors receive personal violation notices and, after warning, may be made personally liable for outstanding ESR penalties and restoration costs. The court may disqualify directors for up to 5 years and issue a personal financial conduct prohibition applicable within Vanuatu and in jurisdictions granting mutual legal assistance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The registered agent files an annual return claiming no changes to the beneficial ownership register while the IC's actual shareholding is transferred through unrecorded trust arrangements; failure to conduct CDD on non-resident clients whose funds are used for the localization agency; or using the IC to receive tens of thousands of dollars from unknown third-party payment platforms while concealing origin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 2 of 2014; fines are imposed per contravention and can include amounts up to VT 5,000,000 for natural persons and VT 20,000,000 for legal persons, plus confiscation proceedings. The VFSC may refer the matter to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who authorized or was willfully blind to the omission is personally criminally liable and may be imprisoned for up to 12 months per count. The court can also make a restraint order against the director's personal bank accounts and assets, and the director can be added to an international financial restrictions list.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing and Foreign CFC Enforcement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The localization agency charges affiliated offshore clients excessively low or zero prices for media dubbing and translation services, shifts profit away from the intellectual property owner, or fails to maintain transactional evidence for a related-party arrangement despite the arrangement being systematically reviewed by the client's home jurisdiction tax authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu itself imposes no domestic transfer pricing penalty. However, the foreign tax administration may re-determine the arm's length income, deny deductions, apply withholding tax on recommputed income, impose 10%-40% transfer pricing penalties, and initiate joint tax audits. Repeat violations can lead to the IC being characterized as a controlled foreign corporation inside the shareholder's jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If the transfer pricing manipulation constitutes fraudulent evasion of foreign tax, directors may be named in foreign civil recovery proceedings, and courts may pierce the IC in cases where the directors personally authorized unrewarded profit stripping. Personal liability attaches to directors who sign false transfer pricing certificates, and certain jurisdictions allow extradition or travel bans for serious tax abuse.
